what: When swapping stacked slides (photo · video), the screen is split into cells mixing thin vertical strips (260 cells) and thick strips (26 cells), each cell melts at a different time (progress − cell value × .4), stretching up and down (max .38 of the screen), and passes to the next slide around the midpoint. While melting, wave noise ripples it sideways by .05 · .08 and dust specks drift in, and the cell order is reshuffled each time. Linear 950ms — for slide changes in the immersive brand edition and video gallery transitions

options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Stacked sections — img, video, canvas, or a panel containing them. A panel without an image melts into a single background color. The current section has is-active
options.fx:goto: Send with detail.index on an element to jump to that section (for pairing with the section-flip and scroll panels)
options.fx:swap: Event fired from the element when switching starts (detail.from, to)

note: The video section is redrawn every frame while melting, so it melts while moving. If CORS blocks an image from another source, a single background color stands in

from.where: about.js section-change background canvas .br-bg — original brand section transition (WebGL melt 950ms · 12 vertical smears · cells 260/26)
